profile.baseCurrencyHint: Net worth, reports and envelopes are in this currency. It cannot change while the budget has assignments.

security.title: Change password
security.othersSignedOut: Other devices will be signed out.

confirmIdentity.title: Confirm it is you
confirmIdentity.passwordHint: To change how you sign in, enter your current password.
confirmIdentity.codeHint: To change how you sign in, enter a code from the authenticator app or a recovery code.

google.title: Sign in with Google
google.text: Sign in with one click, without a password. The 2FA code is still asked when it is on.
google.setPasswordFirst: Set a password before disconnecting Google, or there will be no way to sign in.

errors.taken: This Google account is already connected to another WebWallet account.
errors.failed: Could not connect Google. Please try again.

password.title: Password
password.none: No password yet: you sign in with Google. We will email you a link to set one.
password.sent: We have sent you the link

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.text: Signing in needs a code from an authenticator app besides the password: Google Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden and the like.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Cannot scan? Enter the key by hand:
twoFactor.codesWarning: Keep these codes somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, only they will let you sign in. Each code works once, and we show them only now.
twoFactor.saved: I have saved the recovery codes
twoFactor.disableText: Signing in will need only the password again. Recovery codes and trusted devices will be deleted.
twoFactor.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app or a recovery code
twoFactor.newCodesText: The old recovery codes will stop working. Confirm with a code from the app.

data.exportText: A ZIP archive with all your data: accounts, transactions, categories, budget, goals, investments, taxes.
data.exportCsv: transactions for Excel or Google Sheets
data.exportSecrets: Bank tokens and the password are not exported.

delete.title: Delete the account?
delete.blocked: The account is blocked at once and you are signed out on all devices.
delete.erased: On {{date}} accounts, transactions, the budget, investments and all other data will be erased for good.
delete.cancel: Until then you can cancel: with the link in the email or by signing in again.
delete.exportFirst: Save a copy of your data first.
delete.confirmEmail: Type the email of this account
delete.doneText: The account will be deleted on {{date}}. We sent a link to cancel to {{email}}. You will be signed out now.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.resetText: Deletes all accounts, transactions, envelopes, payees, tags and bank connections. Your profile and password stay.
danger.resetWarning: This cannot be undone. Consider an export first.
danger.done: Your data is deleted. You can start over.
danger.deleteText: The account is blocked and deleted with all its data after 14 days. Until then you can cancel.

categories.dragHint: Drag by the handle to reorder or to move a subcategory into another group.
categories.necessityHint: Needs or wants is used for 50/30/20 analytics.
categories.parentLocked: A category with subcategories is a group itself
categories.inheritsIcon: Without its own icon the group icon is used
categories.archivedHelp: Archived categories are hidden in forms; their transactions and reports stay.
categories.deleteText: A category can be deleted only while it has no transactions or budget amounts. Otherwise archive it.

dnd.instructions: To move a category, press space, use the up and down arrows, and press space again. Escape cancels.

rules.hint: Rules categorize new transactions. When you change a category by hand, a rule for the payee is learned automatically.

payees.hint: Payees come from transactions. Deleting one keeps its transactions.
payees.deleteText: Transactions stay, without a payee; rules for it are removed.

tags.hint: Tags group transactions across categories, e.g. #vacation.
tags.deleteText: The tag is removed from all transactions; the transactions stay.

telegram.text: The bot reminds you of payments, budgets and tax deadlines, and an expense takes one message: "150 coffee".
telegram.pending: Open the bot {{bot}} and press "Start". The link works once, for 15 minutes. This page updates by itself.
telegram.expired: The link to connect Telegram has expired. Create a new one.
telegram.linkedAs: {{name}}, connected on {{date}}. You can also disconnect with /stop in the bot.
telegram.disabled: The Telegram bot is unavailable right now.
telegram.accountHint: "150 coffee" and "+5000 salary" go here when the message names no account. When the bank sends the same operation, there is no duplicate.

notifications.notLinked: The Telegram switches work once the bot is connected.

recurring.title: Recurring payments
recurring.text: The day before and on the day of a payment not yet linked to an operation. "Paid" records the operation, "All planned" shows the payments of 30 days (like /planned).

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.text: When the spending of a category reaches 80 % and 100 % of the month’s budget, once a month each.

taxes.title: Sole proprietor taxes
taxes.text: 7 days and a day before the deadline to pay the single tax and the social contribution and to file the declaration.

banks.title: Banks
banks.text: Monobank no longer accepts the token. Comes at once, but not from 22:00 to 8:00 — then in the morning.

forecast.title: Balance forecast
forecast.text: The forecast goes below zero within 30 days. Again only when the date or the amount changes.

weekly.title: Weekly analysis
weekly.text: Mondays, except in the first week of a month: a chart of the spending from the 1st against the same days of the previous month, and the categories that changed most.

monthly.title: Month summary
monthly.text: On the 1st: the previous month against the month before — income, spending, savings and a chart by category.

notifications.emailHint: The spending analysis goes to {{email}}. Every email has an “Unsubscribe” link.
